target_customer: Hardware startups and electronics teams that design PCBs in KiCad or Altium
problem: Building correct footprints, symbols and 3D models from manufacturer datasheets is slow and error prone work for PCB designers.
business_model: Service subscription for custom PCB library parts, with a free trial
product_category: Electronics design services, PCB component libraries

competitors.name: SnapEDA (now SnapMagic Search)
competitors.what: Free symbols, footprints and 3D models for millions of parts
competitors.traction_then: Described as the most popular third party library for KiCad users

competitors.name: SamacSys Component Search Engine
competitors.what: Library loader plus a build request service for missing parts

competitors.name: Ultra Librarian
competitors.what: Large PCB CAD library with distributor partnerships
competitors.traction_then: Self described as the world's largest PCB CAD library

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting accurate pin to pad data from datasheets needs careful verification, and automating it with AI is moderate engineering with accuracy risk.

defensibility.rationale: A per customer library standard creates some lock in, but free and large incumbent libraries make the wedge easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent libraries already sell the same outputs and offer build requests. No source shows any acquiring or copying Stillwind.

market_need_then: PCB library creation is a recurring cost for design teams, and existing providers sell build on request services, which indicates paid demand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical, tagline Built to your standard

rebrands.why: Not stated. The YC pages show Augento (reinforcement fine tuning for AI agents) in the same batch with the same founders.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Stillwind is active in Zurich with three ETH Zurich founders in a service business against established free and paid libraries. The YC pages suggest the same founders earlier ran Augento, an AI fine tuning product, but no pivot date or reason is sourced, and no funding or outcome is public.
notes: No funding figures found. A Swiss registry listing shows Stillwind Labs GmbH as active per a search snippet. The Augento to Stillwind link is inferred from matching founders on YC pages, and a search snippet reports different team size (4) and product (Stillwind Search) than the current page. The pivot date is unknown so it is recorded as a rebrand with a null date and no pivot entry.
